about.title: A technical organization dedicated to the Tunisian road network.
about.lead: Founded in 2018, the Tunisian Road Association brings together public officials, engineers, construction companies, academics, and experts around technical innovation, quality, and infrastructure safety.
about.body: ATR is presided over by Mrs. Lilia Sifaoui, General Director of the Bizerte New Bridge Management Unit. It works in close collaboration with the Ministry of Equipment and Housing and represents Tunisia within PIARC.
about.caption1: Tunisian Road Association — institutional visual of ATR.
about.history_title: A trajectory rooted in technical exchange
about.history_1_text: Birth of the Tunisian association dedicated to scientific and professional exchanges on roads.
about.history_2_text: PIARC, international partner of ATR, is founded as the World Road Association.
about.history_3_text: ATR connects administration, construction, engineering, laboratories, and universities around tangible projects.
about.mission_title: Uniting the expertise that builds roads.
about.mission_body: ATR provides a platform for dialogue among stakeholders who design, build, maintain, and study road infrastructure. It fosters method sharing, quality standards enforcement, and translating research into operational solutions.
about.hss_body: The 'Vision Zero Fatalities' approach places human life protection at the core of design, operation, and prevention decisions.
about.pillar1_text: Mitigate risks for road users, operators, and construction work crews.
about.pillar2_text: Disseminate health, safety, and quality practices aligned with international standards.
about.pillar3_text: Design infrastructures that minimize the consequences of human error.
about.activity1_text: Gather public, private, and academic stakeholders around technical challenges of the road network.
about.activity2_text: Structure expertise working groups on design, safety, structures, and resilience.
about.activity3_text: Provide technical resources and field feedback for road sector professionals.
about.activity4_text: Connect Tunisian experts to the works of the World Road Association, founded in 1909.
about.ct1_text: Asset management, climate adaptation, and service continuity.
about.ct2_text: Data, connected mobility, corridor decarbonization, and intermodality.
about.ct3_text: Safety audits, black spot mitigation, and road hazard prevention.
about.ct4_text: Pavement design, monitoring, bridge maintenance, and recycled materials.

pub_hss.title: Zero Fatalities: ATR Takes on the OHS Challenge of a "Forgiving Road"
pub_hss.hero_alt: Zero Fatalities: ATR takes on the OHS challenge of a forgiving road
pub_hss.lead_1: On April 30, 2026, the Tunisian Road Association (ATR) held a conference dedicated to OHS challenges and road safety on work sites, gathering Ministry of Equipment and Housing officials, engineers, HSE managers, academics, students, and industry professionals at the City of Sciences.
pub_hss.p_1: Discussions quickly expanded beyond purely technical parameters: behind regulations, procedures, and infrastructure, human responsibility stood firmly at the center of the debate.
pub_hss.spk1_title: President of the Tunisian Road Association (ATR) & General Director of the New Bizerte Bridge Management Unit
pub_hss.spk1_text: The opening address was delivered by Lilia Sifaoui. Presenting ATR, established in 2018, she recalled the association's collaborative work with the Ministry of Equipment and Housing on infrastructure and road safety priorities. She also commended the Ministry's sustained commitment to these strategic goals.
pub_hss.p_2: Throughout the presentations, OHS (Health, Safety and Security) established itself as an indispensable component in executing major infrastructure projects.
pub_hss.p_3: Several speakers stressed the need to overcome the persistent perception that safety requirements hinder project progress or burden financial margins. On the contrary, mastering OHS standards is now an essential benchmark of credibility, governance, and operational performance for contractors and public institutions alike.
pub_hss.spk2_title: Deputy Director at the Ministry of Equipment and Housing & ATR Board Member
pub_hss.spk2_text1: Taking the floor, Eya Soueb revisited ISO standards and the practical hurdles of their field implementation. She emphasized that no preventive framework can yield results without tangible coordination among project sponsors, contractors, and public authorities.
pub_hss.spk2_text2: The exchange underscored that international donors require strict compliance with international road and work-site safety standards as mandatory conditions for investment, safeguarding both lives and institutional reputation. Eya Soueb also addressed disbursement delays and recruitment for training, emphasizing continuous awareness across both experienced and incoming industry staff.
pub_hss.p_4: Before an attentive audience, discussions progressed from technical frameworks to address a sobering reality: the human tragedies resulting from safety failures.
pub_hss.spk3_text: Ahmed Ksentini's intervention engaged the room with its direct and profoundly human perspective. Evoking road deaths as a critical scourge, he regretted that these losses are still too often treated as unavoidable fate.
pub_hss.quote1_text: "Where there is a will, there is a way. The 'zero fatalities' goal must not be treated as a mere institutional slogan, but as an absolute requirement: a single life lost is already an immense tragedy."
pub_hss.spk3_ending: Stressing that a safe road is fundamentally a basic human right, he also advocated for integrating road safety disciplines deeper into academic curricula for future sector professionals.
pub_hss.h3_causes: Collective Reflection and Concrete Work-Site Causes
pub_hss.causes_intro: During an open exchange with an engaged audience, participants analyzed core accident causes on work sites. Key focus areas included:
pub_hss.cause_1: Strengthening rigorous, unannounced inspections across all public infrastructure sites.
pub_hss.cause_2: Strict issuance of formal compliance certificates before any actual start of construction.
pub_hss.cause_3: Mandating certified and appropriate safety equipment provided by contracting firms on major projects.
pub_hss.spk4_title: Head of Service at the Bizerte Bridge Implementation Unit
pub_hss.spk4_text1: For her part, Arij Naili addressed causes of accidents linked to work-site non-compliance. Recalling the tragic worker fatality that occurred on March 20, 2023, following safety lapses on a construction site, her address solemnly highlighted the tangible impact of human and organizational breakdowns.
pub_hss.spk4_text2: She underscored that, despite existing regulations, the core challenge remains human behavior and active observance of safety rules across both site workers and hierarchy. Moving forward, the imperative is instilling a genuine culture of shared responsibility across businesses and field specialists.
pub_hss.spk5_text: The regulatory dimension also received focused attention, alongside proposals for a standardized field application handbook. Khaled Sioud urged the adoption of clearer legal texts to establish explicit accountability and penalties for safety negligence.
pub_hss.quote2_text: "The road must forgive. It is not merely a question of pedestrian or driver distraction, but of the environment and conditions under which they move. Infrastructure must be engineered to minimize the consequences of human error as much as possible."
pub_hss.quote2_author: — Khaled Sioud, Civil Engineer & OHS Expert
pub_hss.resolutions_intro: As the session drew to a close, a clear consensus was established: safety can no longer be treated as an optional technical annex appended at the end of a project. It demands:
pub_hss.res_1: Appropriate protective equipment available and deployed right from the site setup phase.
pub_hss.res_2: A clearly defined, dedicated budget line in pricing schedules to prevent compromising on worker protection.
pub_hss.res_3: Unannounced, regular audits conducted in tandem with HSE safety teams.
pub_hss.res_4: Fully shared accountability between contracting authorities and executing construction firms.
pub_hss.res_5: A sustainable, long-term prevention vision integrated from the earliest stages of university engineering education.
pub_hss.lead_ending: The meeting ended at 5:00 PM with cordial exchanges. Beyond technical and institutional discussions, one shared conviction anchored the day: modernizing infrastructure can never be separated from protecting human life.

pub_ministre.title: The Minister of Equipment Welcomes the New Board of the Tunisian Road Association
pub_ministre.location: Ministry of Equipment and Housing, Tunis
pub_ministre.hero_alt: The Minister of Equipment receiving the newly elected ATR Executive Board
pub_ministre.lead: This Monday morning, Mr. Salah Zouari, Minister of Equipment and Housing, received the members of the newly elected Executive Board of the Tunisian Road Association (ATR). The meeting took place in the presence of the First Delegate of the World Road Association (PIARC) and PIARC's Technical Advisor.
pub_ministre.spk_min_title: Minister of Equipment and Housing — Republic of Tunisia
pub_ministre.spk_min_p1: At the outset of the meeting, the Minister commended the association's prominent role in organizing national and international forums on infrastructure and transport, actively contributing to knowledge sharing and expertise in this field.
pub_ministre.spk_min_p2: He emphasized the necessity of sustaining these efforts to amplify the association's influence both locally and internationally and to further deepen institutional cooperation with the Ministry.
pub_ministre.quote_text: "The Minister commended the association's prominent role in organizing national and international forums on infrastructure and transport, actively fostering knowledge sharing and promoting Tunisian engineering excellence."
pub_ministre.quote_author: — Mr. Salah Zouari, Minister of Equipment and Housing
pub_ministre.spk_pres_title: President of the Tunisian Road Association (ATR) & General Director of the Bizerte Bridge Management Unit
pub_ministre.spk_pres_text: For her part, Mrs. Lilia Sifaoui, President of the association, presented an overview of the strategy and strategic goals of the new executive board. She stated that a targeted action plan is currently being drafted to align with modern expectations and future visions, aiming to enhance the association's performance and bolster its supporting role in the road and infrastructure sector across Tunisia.
pub_ministre.conclusion: This official audience seals reinforced partnership between the State and ATR, reaffirming the association's role as a trusted interlocutor for public authorities and the World Road Association (PIARC).

pub_glissements.title: Technical Day: Landslides and Infrastructure Resilience
pub_glissements.hero_alt: ATR ATMS Landslides Technical Day - El Mouradi Gammarth Hotel
pub_glissements.lead: This symposium gathered experts, engineers, academics, infrastructure managers, and industry professionals around a common mission: to better understand, anticipate, and manage geotechnical risks threatening our transport infrastructures and territories.
pub_glissements.p_1: Throughout the day, participants engaged on major themes: landslide mechanisms, stabilization and reinforcement techniques, stormwater management, the impact of extreme rainfall, and actionable field experience on road and rail structures.
pub_glissements.p_2: Discussions highlighted the vital necessity of an integrated approach blending engineering expertise, innovation, continuous monitoring, and climate adaptation to bolster infrastructure resilience and ensure long-term sustainability.
pub_glissements.p_3: The depth of presentations, high standard of debate, and breadth of shared experiences affirmed the need to sustain such initiatives to support sector stakeholders facing current and emerging challenges.
pub_glissements.thanks_p1: We extend our deepest gratitude to the Minister of Equipment and Housing for his backing of this initiative and his keen interest in elevating technical capabilities, infrastructure safety, and territorial resilience against natural hazards.
pub_glissements.thanks_p2: His steadfast commitment to infrastructure modernization and durability provides vital encouragement to all industry professionals. Sincere appreciation to all speakers, partners, sponsors, and participants who contributed to this seminar's success.
pub_glissements.quote_text: "Together for safer, more resilient infrastructure better adapted to tomorrow's climate challenges."

communiques.c01_title: Official audience dedicated to the new executive board of the Tunisian Road Association
communiques.c01_p1: The Tunisian Road Association announces that an official audience dedicated to its newly elected executive board was held with Mr. Salah Zouari, Minister of Equipment and Housing.
communiques.c01_p2: The meeting took place in the presence of the First Delegate of the World Road Association (PIARC) and his technical advisor. It focused on ATR's mission in organizing national and international symposiums on road infrastructure and mobility.
communiques.c01_p3: This audience also provided an opportunity to present the roadmap of the new executive board and to reaffirm the strategic partnership between ATR, the Ministry, and road research networks.

event_ag.hl_2_desc: Discover ATR's strategic orientations for developing sustainable road infrastructure.
